url.description: The tested page URL (with https:// added if you left it out).

status.description: ok if the test finished, error if it failed. Error rows are not charged.

error.description: Plain reason when status is error (for example a bad API key or URL, API not enabled for the key, quota exceeded), otherwise null.

scores.description: Lighthouse category scores 0-100 for the categories you selected, keyed by category name (for example {"performance": 87}). Empty object on error.

labMetrics.description: Lab metrics from Lighthouse: lcpMs, cls, tbtMs, fcpMs, speedIndexMs, ttiMs. A value is null if Lighthouse did not report it. Empty object on error.

fieldDataPresent.description: true if Google has real-user (field) data for this exact URL.

fieldData.description: Real-user Core Web Vitals for this URL, from the Chrome UX Report via PageSpeed Insights: lcpMs, inpMs, cls (each {value, category}) and overallCategory. Null if Google has none for the URL.

originFieldData.description: The same real-user Core Web Vitals for the whole origin (site), or null if Google has none.
